title: Plant Manager
description:
**Role Description**
The Plant Manager role at RK CONSTRUCTION is a part-time, remote position responsible for overseeing daily plant-related activities and ensuring efficient operations. The Plant Manager will coordinate plant operations, monitor production schedules, and support manufacturing processes to meet project timelines and quality standards. This role includes analyzing operational performance, implementing process improvements, and collaborating with project and site teams to ensure materials and equipment are available as needed. The Plant Manager will also help maintain safety and compliance standards, prepare basic reports on plant performance, and communicate regularly with leadership to align plant activities with overall construction project requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Plant Management and Plant Operations.
* Candidates should possess skills in Operations Management and Production Planning.
* Candidates should possess skills in Manufacturing Operations.
* Experience in construction, infrastructure, or related industrial environments is beneficial.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage remote responsibilities effectively.
* Proven ability to work safely, follow regulatory and company guidelines, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Relevant technical or engineering education, or equivalent practical experience in plant or operations management, is preferred.
